prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: Create a high-resolution studio portrait of a young, androgynous male model standing against a seamless, pure white background. The subject is posed frontally from the waist up, with a relaxed, confident posture and a subtle, neutral facial expression. He has straight, medium-length brown hair with bangs that frame his face, and his skin is smooth and evenly lit. The model is shirtless, revealing a lean, athletic build and small, minimalist tattoos on both upper arms. The lighting is soft and diffused, eliminating harsh shadows and creating a clean, modern aesthetic. The overall composition is minimalist, with a focus on the subject’s natural features and the simplicity of the setting. The color palette is muted and natural, emphasizing skin tones and the stark contrast with the white background. The image has a fashion editorial quality, with sharp focus and a shallow depth of field that keeps the model crisp against the unobtrusive backdrop.
